messages:
charlie_corp: Hey, we flipped json_mode=\"strict\" and now a handful of requests are failing with 422. Happening on our ingestion endpoint only. Repro steps below.

alice_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the original request body + the API error (response body)? :eyes:

charlie_corp: Payload we send (shortened):
```json
{
  \"user_id\": \"123456\",    // user ids are strings in our DB
  \"score\": \"0.95\",      // we send as string for precision reasons
  \"active\": null,             // sometimes null
  \"state\": \"ACTIVE\"     // uppercase enum from legacy system
}
```
API returned 422 with body:
```json
{
  \"error\": \"invalid_json_output\",
  \"detail\": \"field 'score' expected number but got string\"
}
```

alice_support: Got it. So json_mode=strict is rejecting stringified numbers and null booleans. Can you confirm which endpoint and SDK/version?

charlie_corp: Endpoint: POST /v1/infer/structured (our service id: svc-9f2). Using node-sdk v1.3.2. Happens intermittently — only when active is null and score is a quoted number.

bob_engineering: Repro steps I ran locally: 1) set json_mode: \"strict\" in request 2) send body exactly as above 3) response 422 with validation error. Quick curl we used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/infer/structured \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{\"json_mode\":\"strict\",\"input\": {\"user_id\":\"123456\",\"score\":\"0.95\",\"active\":null,\"state\":\"ACTIVE\"}}'
```

bob_engineering: Observed server-side validation: service schema expects score:number, active:boolean (nullable allowed) but strict path refuses null for boolean if value is null (it treats null and false differently) and refuses quoted numbers.

alice_support: That matches the customer's report. Two things to decide: customer wants either (A) the platform to coerce types (\"0.95\" -> 0.95, null -> false?) or (B) tell them exact payload changes to avoid 422s. Which do we want to offer?

charlie_corp: Ideally platform coercion for backward compat. But temporary fix: we'll send score as unquoted number and send active:false instead of null. Not ideal but doable.

bob_engineering: Quick root cause: strict JSON mode enforces schema types exactly and also enforces enum casing (we treat enums as case-sensitive). So \"ACTIVE\" != \"active\". We have a ticket to consider a coercion opt-in flag but not currently available.

dana_sre: tagging deploy_bot for logs around 2029-10-12T09:00:00Z window — can we get request IDs for failed requests?

deploy_bot: Logs found for svc-9f2 between 1887654200 and 1887654900. Sample request_id: r-0a1b2c3d. Attach the request_id and we can trace stronger.

alice_support: Action items: 1) Ask customer to change score to numeric (no quotes) and active to explicit boolean (true/false) and lowercase enum (\"active\") for canary. 2) Escalate to eng to evaluate a permissive coercion mode (coerce_types: true) or schema-aware tolerant parsing. Bob, can you open an eng ticket and mark P2?

bob_engineering: Will open ENG-1147. I'll include repro, curl, and logs from deploy_bot. Proposal will include: optional request param `coerce_types=true` that will attempt safe conversions (quoted numbers -> numbers, \"true\"/\"false\" -> booleans, null preserved but accepted for nullable fields) and a case-insensitive enum matching toggle.

charlie_corp: Thanks — for immediate unblock we pushed a patch to our integration to send numeric score and explicit booleans. Will monitor and report back in 24h. Appreciated. :pray:

alice_support: LGTM — marking thread for follow-up once ENG-1147 has design. If you see other errors, drop the request_id here and we'll trace.

charlie_corp: one more note — we have hundreds of old rows where user_id is a string (\"123456\") and some services expect integer ids. If you add coercion please make sure large id strings don't get truncated.

bob_engineering: Good call. We'll include safe integer parsing and a max-precision policy in the ticket.

alice_support: Closing for now, re-open when you see fresh failures. :white_check_mark:
